examples.arabic: فكرة ممتازة، لأنني أحتاج حقاً إلى الوضوء بالماء البارد كي أستعيد نشاطي المفقود قبل تناول تلك الشاورما الساخنة.
examples.english: Excellent idea, because I really need to perform ablution with cold water in order to regain my lost energy before eating that hot shawarma.
examples.transliteration: Fikra mumtaza, li-annani ahtaju haqqan ila al-wudu' bil-ma' al-barid kay asta'ida nashati al-mafqud qabla tanawul tilka ash-shawarma as-sakhina.
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.english: I drank some water and we talked.

examples.arabic: سأطلب بعض الماء بعد قليل عندما يأتي احمد
examples.english: I will order some water soon when Ahmed arrives.
examples.transliteration: Sa'atlubu ba'd al-ma' ba'da qaleel 'indama ya'ti Ahmad

examples.arabic: الوقت طويل جدا و انا اشرب الماء فقط
examples.english: The time is very long and I only drink water.
examples.transliteration: Al-waqtu taweelun jiddan wa ana ashrabu al-maa'a faqat.

examples.arabic: كان هناك قط صغير يلعب بالماء
examples.english: There was a small cat playing with the water
examples.transliteration: Kana hunaka qitt saghir yal'abu bil-ma'
